newsitem.title: JAPAN: Daiei sees 10 bln yen 97/98 current prft.
newsitem.headline: Daiei sees 10 bln yen 97/98 current prft.

text.p: Daiei Inc expects to post a parent current profit of 10 billion yen in the 1997/98 business year, the company's president Isao Nakauchi said on Wednesday.
He also said that the company's operating profit is expected to reach 2.6 trillion yen in 1997/98.
Daiei concurrently revised downward its forecast of parent current profit in the business year which ended on February 28 to 500 million yen from a previous forecast of 13 billion yen.
The company said in a statement that the downward revision was due to sluggish sales, especially of winter apparel.
Daiei executive vice president Jun Nakauchi said that the company expects to post sales of three trillion yen and parent current profits of 60 billion yen in the 2001/02 business year.
He also said the company would reduce its interest-bearing debts by 160 billion yen to 500 billion yen by the end of 2001/02.
Isao Nakauchi said the company expected operating profits of about two billion yen in 1996/97, down from 40.4 billion yen in 1995/96.
As a result of the sharp fall in profits the company would cut the bonuses of its executives, Nakauchi said, but he declined to say by how much they would be cut.
